item: Auto Asociācija (association of authorised car dealers): chairman of the board / president
period: leadership posts since 2006; board post declared in 2022; described as president in May 2026
detail: His 2022 declaration lists a post on the association's board (LETA); his 2022 and 2024 candidate data give him as chairman of the board, and TV3 called him the association's president in May 2026. In a 2026 radio interview he said he had never received any payment for representing the association (Re:Check, LSM). Whether he kept the post as Prime Minister is not reported in the sources consulted.

item: Council member, Latvian Employers' Confederation (Latvijas Darba devēju konfederācija, LDDK)
period: elected 2022; declared in 2022; described as a former member in May 2026
detail: His 2022 declaration lists a post on the LDDK council (LETA), and TV3 dates his election to 2022; LSM's May 2026 profile describes him as having been a council member. He said he received no payment from the LDDK (Re:Check, LSM).
